## Menubar.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The open menu's value, or `null` when every menu is closed. Bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the open menu changes.
- `loop` :: Whether arrow keys wrap from the last trigger to the first.
- `surface` :: The fill of every menu panel, unless a menu overrides it.
- `gap` :: The space between the menus.
- `label` :: The accessible name of the menubar.
- `children` :: The `MenubarMenu` children.

## MenubarMenu.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The value this menu contributes to the menubar when it is open.
- `label` :: The default trigger label. Ignored when `trigger` is provided.
- `trigger` :: The button that opens the menu. Spread `props` onto your own button.
- `surface` :: The fill of this menu panel. Falls back to the menubar's `surface`.
- `size` :: The height of the trigger.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the trigger label.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the trigger.
- `textColor` :: Ink of the menu chevron.
- `disabled` :: Disables the trigger and prevents the menu from opening.
- `children` :: The items, labels, separators and submenus.

## menubar.ts

### `type MenubarIntent`

Which end of the newly opened menu should receive focus.

### `interface MenubarContext`

Shared state between the menubar and each of its menus.

- `uid` :: The bar's unique id prefix.
- `value` :: The open menu's value, or `null` when every menu is closed.
- `setValue` :: Opens the menu with this value, or closes the bar when `null`.
- `intent` :: Where focus should land in a menu that has just opened.
- `loop` :: Whether arrow keys wrap from the last trigger to the first.
- `surface` :: The default fill of every menu panel.
- `move` :: Moves to the adjacent enabled menu, opening it when one is already open.

### `const menubarRoving`

Roving options for the top-level triggers — skips items inside menu popovers.
